verification_instructions: 1) Run `cd /Users/aryansinghthakur/Downloads/Veducore/app && npx tsc --noEmit` — must pass with 0 errors. 2) Start app with `expo start` and verify in simulator: teacher login routes to teacher tabs with glass UI, parent login routes to parent tabs.
environment_constraints: No @react-native-community/blur available — glassmorphism must be simulated with semi-transparent LinearGradient + View borders. No test runner. expo-router uses file-system routing: folders named (group) become tab groups. Each (group) needs a _layout.tsx. Expo SDK 57 / RN 0.86.3.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code style: StyleSheet.create at bottom of file, useCallback for all data-loading functions, TEACHER_ID/SCHOOL_ID constants at top of file, `mockDb.*` for all data access, no external HTTP calls.
key_patterns: 1) Data access: always use `mockDb.query<T>(table, filters)` or `mockDb.getAll<T>(table)`. Never access AsyncStorage directly in screens. 2) Screens: SafeAreaView + ScrollView + RefreshControl pattern. 3) Loading state: useState(true) + finally(() => setLoading(false)). 4) All teacher screens hardcode `TEACHER_ID = 'teacher-001'` and `SCHOOL_ID = 'school-001'`. 5) Glassmorphism: LinearGradient background (GLASS_BG colors) + GlassCard component (rgba fills, no blur). 6) Auth: `useAuth()` gives `{ user: Profile | null }`. Parent resolution: query 'parents' by `user_id: user.id` to get `parent_id`, then query 'parent_students' by `parent_id` to get student IDs.
